units.english: Refugees to <planet>
units.italian: Profughi verso <planet>

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|description|569|0
units.english: Joe and Maria, a young couple with a newborn baby, want to escape slavery and start a new life on <destination>.
units.italian: Joe e Maria, una giovane coppia con un neonato, vogliono sfuggire alla schiavitù e iniziare una nuova vita su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|You wander into one of several dimly lit, smoke-filled bars near your docking bay. Soon after you sit down, a pair of hooded figures stand up and begin moving toward you. They aren't carrying any visible weapons, but on a station like this one there's a good chance that everyone you meet has a concealed gun. One of them is carrying a bundle wrapped in cloth. You can't see their faces.|576|0
units.english: You wander into one of several dimly lit, smoke-filled bars near your docking bay. Soon after you sit down, a pair of hooded figures stand up and begin moving toward you. They aren't carrying any visible weapons, but on a station like this one there's a good chance that everyone you meet has a concealed gun. One of them is carrying a bundle wrapped in cloth. You can't see their faces.
units.italian: Ti infili in uno dei tanti bar poco illuminati e pieni di fumo vicino alla tua piazzola di atterraggio. Poco dopo che ti sei seduto, due figure incappucciate si alzano e cominciano a muoversi verso di te. Non portano armi visibili, ma su una stazione come questa è molto probabile che chiunque incontri abbia una pistola nascosta. Uno dei due tiene un fagotto avvolto in un panno. Non riesci a vedere le loro facce.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	(Get out of here.)|578|0
units.english: (Get out of here.)
units.italian: (Vattene da qui.)

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	(Wait and see what they want.)|579|0
units.english: (Wait and see what they want.)
units.italian: (Aspetta e vedi cosa vogliono.)

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	You've heard too many stories of kidnappings and murders on this station to be willing to take any risks. You quickly get up and leave the bar, and walk down the passageway back toward your ship. Glancing behind you, you see that the hooded figures have decided not to follow you.|582|0
units.english: You've heard too many stories of kidnappings and murders on this station to be willing to take any risks. You quickly get up and leave the bar, and walk down the passageway back toward your ship. Glancing behind you, you see that the hooded figures have decided not to follow you.
units.italian: Hai sentito troppe storie di rapimenti e omicidi su questa stazione per correre rischi. Ti alzi in fretta, lasci il bar e percorri il corridoio verso la nave. Guardando alle tue spalle, vedi che le figure incappucciate hanno deciso di non seguirti.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	The hooded figures turn out to be a boy and a girl, both perhaps thirteen or fourteen years old. The bundle in the girl's arms is a baby. "Are you a captain?" the boy asks.|586|0
units.english: The hooded figures turn out to be a boy and a girl, both perhaps thirteen or fourteen years old. The bundle in the girl's arms is a baby. "Are you a captain?" the boy asks.
units.italian: Le figure incappucciate si rivelano un ragazzo e una ragazza, entrambi forse sui tredici o quattordici anni. Il fagotto tra le braccia della ragazza è un neonato. "Lei è un capitano?" chiede il ragazzo.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	"Yes," you say.|587|0
units.english: "Yes," you say.
units.italian: "Sì," dici.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	"We're looking for passage off-world," he says. "My cousin works in the refineries on Arabia, and I'm hoping he can get me a job there."|588|0
units.english: "We're looking for passage off-world," he says. "My cousin works in the refineries on Arabia, and I'm hoping he can get me a job there."
units.italian: "Cerchiamo un passaggio per andare via dal pianeta," dice. "Mio cugino lavora nelle raffinerie su Arabia, e spero che possa trovarmi un lavoro lì."

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	"I don't want to be involved in anything illegal. Are you in some sort of trouble with the law?"|590|0
units.english: "I don't want to be involved in anything illegal. Are you in some sort of trouble with the law?"
units.italian: "Non voglio essere coinvolto in nulla di illegale. Avete problemi con la legge?"

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	"Well, how much would you be able to pay me?"|592|0
units.english: "Well, how much would you be able to pay me?"
units.italian: "Beh, quanto potreste pagarmi?"

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	The boy grins. "No, not at all. I mean, aside from the fact that we're pirates."|596|0
units.english: The boy grins. "No, not at all. I mean, aside from the fact that we're pirates."
units.italian: Il ragazzo sorride. "No, per niente. Cioè, a parte il fatto che siamo pirati."

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	Seeing the incredulous look on your face, the girl says, "Members of a pirate gang. Crew on a pirate ship. Captains are usually older, but most of the pirate ships you see out there are crewed by kids like us. It's a hard place to grow up. We want something better for our daughter."|597|0
units.english: Seeing the incredulous look on your face, the girl says, "Members of a pirate gang. Crew on a pirate ship. Captains are usually older, but most of the pirate ships you see out there are crewed by kids like us. It's a hard place to grow up. We want something better for our daughter."
units.italian: Vedendo la tua espressione incredula, la ragazza dice: "Membri di una banda di pirati. Equipaggio di una nave pirata. I capitani di solito sono più grandicelli, ma la maggior parte delle navi pirata che vedi là fuori ha un equipaggio di ragazzini come noi. È un posto duro in cui crescere. Vogliamo qualcosa di meglio per nostra figlia."

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	They are silent for a long moment, looking down at the table. Finally, the boy says, "We're crew on a pirate ship, hardly better than slaves. The captain keeps our wages. We don't get paid anything unless they agree to let us go. But if you help us start a new life, we'll work hard and some day we'll pay you back."|601|0
units.english: They are silent for a long moment, looking down at the table. Finally, the boy says, "We're crew on a pirate ship, hardly better than slaves. The captain keeps our wages. We don't get paid anything unless they agree to let us go. But if you help us start a new life, we'll work hard and some day we'll pay you back."
units.italian: Restano in silenzio a lungo, fissando il tavolo. Alla fine il ragazzo dice: "Siamo equipaggio su una nave pirata, poco meglio che schiavi. Il capitano si tiene la nostra paga. Non riceviamo niente a meno che non ci lascino andare. Ma se ci aiuti a ricominciare, lavoreremo sodo e un giorno ti ripagheremo."

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	The girl adds, "You don't know what it's like for a little girl to grow up on a pirate ship. We want something better than that for our daughter."|602|0
units.english: The girl adds, "You don't know what it's like for a little girl to grow up on a pirate ship. We want something better than that for our daughter."
units.italian: La ragazza aggiunge: "Non sai cosa vuol dire per una bambina crescere su una nave pirata. Vogliamo qualcosa di meglio per nostra figlia."

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	As you are conversing a bearded man and a rough-looking teenage boy enter the bar and begin looking around the room. "That's our captain," she says. "Please, you have to help us. There's a service tunnel that connects to the back entrance of the bar. We can escape through there."|605|0
units.english: As you are conversing a bearded man and a rough-looking teenage boy enter the bar and begin looking around the room. "That's our captain," she says. "Please, you have to help us. There's a service tunnel that connects to the back entrance of the bar. We can escape through there."
units.italian: Mentre parlate, un uomo barbuto e un ragazzo dall'aria rude entrano nel bar e cominciano a guardarsi intorno. "Quello è il nostro capitano," dice lei. "Ti prego, devi aiutarci. C'è un tunnel di servizio che si collega all'ingresso sul retro del bar. Possiamo scappare da lì."

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	You've heard of these service passageways: the most dangerous part of this lawless station, dimly lit and seldom traveled, except by drug addicts and prostitutes. This whole thing might just be a ruse to lure you into one, where they can attack you without anyone interfering. "No," says the boy, "if we head for the service tunnel, they'll be sure to notice us. Let's just stay at the table until they go away."|606|0
units.english: You've heard of these service passageways: the most dangerous part of this lawless station, dimly lit and seldom traveled, except by drug addicts and prostitutes. This whole thing might just be a ruse to lure you into one, where they can attack you without anyone interfering. "No," says the boy, "if we head for the service tunnel, they'll be sure to notice us. Let's just stay at the table until they go away."
units.italian: Hai sentito parlare di questi passaggi di servizio: la parte più pericolosa di questa stazione senza legge, poco illuminati e percorsi di rado, tranne che da tossicodipendenti e prostitute. Tutta questa storia potrebbe essere solo una trappola per attirarti in uno di essi, dove potrebbero attaccarti senza che nessuno intervenga. "No," dice il ragazzo, "se puntiamo al tunnel di servizio, ci noteranno di sicuro. Restiamo al tavolo finché non se ne vanno."

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	The baby begins to cry, softly, and she bounces it gently, trying desperately to quiet it. "Shh. Shh." For the moment, it falls silent.|607|0
units.english: The baby begins to cry, softly, and she bounces it gently, trying desperately to quiet it. "Shh. Shh." For the moment, it falls silent.
units.italian: La neonata comincia a piangere, piano, e lei la culla dolcemente, cercando disperatamente di calmarla. "Shh. Shh." Per il momento tace.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	(Try the service tunnel.)|609|0
units.english: (Try the service tunnel.)
units.italian: (Prova il tunnel di servizio.)

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	(Wait.)|611|0
units.english: (Wait.)
units.italian: (Aspetta.)

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	"I'm sorry, this isn't worth risking my life for. I'm leaving."|613|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, this isn't worth risking my life for. I'm leaving."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non vale il rischio della mia vita. Me ne vado."

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	You stand up and leave. The men in the doorway make no effort to stop you.|615|0
units.english: You stand up and leave. The men in the doorway make no effort to stop you.
units.italian: Ti alzi e te ne vai. Gli uomini sulla porta non fanno nulla per fermarti.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	The boy stands up. "Wait ten seconds, then head to the tunnel," he says. He walks into the bathroom, which is right next to the back entrance that she pointed out. You wait for a few seconds, then stand up. "Don't run," says the girl. "Walk slowly. Pretend. You've had a bit too much to drink. We're headed out back to find some privacy." You don't dare look behind you to see if the men in the doorway are watching you.|619|0
units.english: The boy stands up. "Wait ten seconds, then head to the tunnel," he says. He walks into the bathroom, which is right next to the back entrance that she pointed out. You wait for a few seconds, then stand up. "Don't run," says the girl. "Walk slowly. Pretend. You've had a bit too much to drink. We're headed out back to find some privacy." You don't dare look behind you to see if the men in the doorway are watching you.
units.italian: Il ragazzo si alza. "Aspetta dieci secondi, poi vai al tunnel," dice. Entra nel bagno, che è proprio accanto all'ingresso sul retro che lei ha indicato. Aspetti qualche secondo, poi ti alzi. "Non correre," dice la ragazza. "Cammina piano. Fai finta. Hai bevuto un po' troppo. Stiamo uscendo dietro per trovare un po' di intimità." Non osi guardare dietro di te per vedere se gli uomini sulla porta ti stanno osservando.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	Finally, you reach the back entrance, and she spins the wheel to unlock it. The hinges squeal, but it opens enough for you to squeeze through. You find yourselves in a narrow corridor lit only by flickering sodium lamps. In the yellow lamplight her face and hands look pale, jaundiced. The floor of the corridor is littered with beer bottles and discarded hypodermic needles. To one side of the door are several over-stuffed trash cans. As you step into the corridor, a rat scurries away into the darkness.|620|0
units.english: Finally, you reach the back entrance, and she spins the wheel to unlock it. The hinges squeal, but it opens enough for you to squeeze through. You find yourselves in a narrow corridor lit only by flickering sodium lamps. In the yellow lamplight her face and hands look pale, jaundiced. The floor of the corridor is littered with beer bottles and discarded hypodermic needles. To one side of the door are several over-stuffed trash cans. As you step into the corridor, a rat scurries away into the darkness.
units.italian: Alla fine raggiungete l'ingresso sul retro, e lei gira il volante per aprirlo. I cardini cigolano, ma si apre abbastanza da permetterti di passare. Vi ritrovate in un corridoio stretto illuminato solo da lampade al sodio che sfarfallano. Alla luce gialla le sue mani e il suo viso sembrano pallidi, itterici. Il pavimento del corridoio è cosparso di bottiglie di birra e aghi ipodermici abbandonati. Da un lato della porta ci sono diversi bidoni della spazzatura stracolmi. Appena entri nel corridoio, un topo scappa via nel buio.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	A few seconds later, watching through the open airlock, you see the boy walk out of the bathroom. He can't help stealing a quick glance towards the men in the doorway, after which he quickly ducks through the airlock and slams the door shut. "Run!" he whispers.|621|0
units.english: A few seconds later, watching through the open airlock, you see the boy walk out of the bathroom. He can't help stealing a quick glance towards the men in the doorway, after which he quickly ducks through the airlock and slams the door shut. "Run!" he whispers.
units.italian: Pochi secondi dopo, guardando attraverso il portello aperto, vedi il ragazzo uscire dal bagno. Non riesce a trattenersi dallo sbirciare verso gli uomini sulla porta, dopodiché si infila in fretta nel portello e lo sbatte. "Corri!" sussurra.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	You begin running down the corridor, in the direction of your ship. You pass a man, slumped over in a corner; there is no time to see if he is dead, or just sleeping. In places the lights have gone out, and it is so dim that you can barely see the floor beneath you. Your footsteps pounding on the metal decking ring terribly loud up and down the empty hallway.|622|0
units.english: You begin running down the corridor, in the direction of your ship. You pass a man, slumped over in a corner; there is no time to see if he is dead, or just sleeping. In places the lights have gone out, and it is so dim that you can barely see the floor beneath you. Your footsteps pounding on the metal decking ring terribly loud up and down the empty hallway.
units.italian: Cominci a correre lungo il corridoio, in direzione della nave. Passi accanto a un uomo accasciato in un angolo; non c'è tempo per capire se è morto o solo addormentato. In alcuni punti le luci sono spente, ed è così buio che riesci a malapena a vedere il pavimento sotto di te. I tuoi passi che martellano sul graticcio metallico rimbombano terribilmente su e giù per il corridoio vuoto.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	Eventually the passageway widens out into a maintenance room, full of humming equipment and large tanks. You duck behind one of them and listen for sounds of pursuit. "I think we're safe," says the boy. He walks over to another airlock door on the opposite wall and tugs it open. Light pours in, almost blinding at first. You are looking out into the rimway, the main passage in this ring of the station. Crowds of people are walking past, paying no attention to you. He glances quickly in both directions, then gestures for you to follow.|623|0
units.english: Eventually the passageway widens out into a maintenance room, full of humming equipment and large tanks. You duck behind one of them and listen for sounds of pursuit. "I think we're safe," says the boy. He walks over to another airlock door on the opposite wall and tugs it open. Light pours in, almost blinding at first. You are looking out into the rimway, the main passage in this ring of the station. Crowds of people are walking past, paying no attention to you. He glances quickly in both directions, then gestures for you to follow.
units.italian: Alla fine il passaggio si allarga in una sala di manutenzione, piena di apparecchiature che ronzano e di grandi serbatoi. Ti nascondi dietro uno di essi e ascolti se qualcuno vi sta inseguendo. "Credo che siamo al sicuro," dice il ragazzo. Si avvicina a un altro portello sulla parete opposta e lo apre con uno strattone. La luce entra, quasi accecante all'inizio. Ti affacci sul rimway, il passaggio principale di questo anello della stazione. Folle di persone passano accanto senza badarvi. Lui guarda in fretta in entrambe le direzioni, poi ti fa cenno di seguirlo.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	You wait at the table, pretending that you are busy placing a drink order. The men at the door do not leave. Instead, they step into the room and begin circling around the edge of it. "What berth is your ship in?" asks the boy. You tell him. "Wait ten seconds, then follow," he says. He stands up and walks through the door. The searchers glance at him as he leaves, but they must be looking for two people together, because they ignore him.|627|0
units.english: You wait at the table, pretending that you are busy placing a drink order. The men at the door do not leave. Instead, they step into the room and begin circling around the edge of it. "What berth is your ship in?" asks the boy. You tell him. "Wait ten seconds, then follow," he says. He stands up and walks through the door. The searchers glance at him as he leaves, but they must be looking for two people together, because they ignore him.
units.italian: Aspetti al tavolo, fingendo di essere occupato a ordinare da bere. Gli uomini alla porta non se ne vanno. Entrano nella sala e cominciano a girare lungo il bordo. "In che ormeggio è la tua nave?" chiede il ragazzo. Glielo dici. "Aspetta dieci secondi, poi segui," dice. Si alza e passa la porta. Quelli che cercano gli lanciano un'occhiata mentre esce, ma devono star cercando due persone insieme, perché lo ignorano.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	The searchers approach the bar and begin talking to one of the bartenders. You and the girl stand up. "Walk slowly," she hisses under her breath. "Saunter. Don't run." You put an arm around her shoulders and do your best to act like an ordinary bar patron headed home with a new friend after having a bit too much to drink. You don't dare to glance at the bar to see if you are being watched.|628|0
units.english: The searchers approach the bar and begin talking to one of the bartenders. You and the girl stand up. "Walk slowly," she hisses under her breath. "Saunter. Don't run." You put an arm around her shoulders and do your best to act like an ordinary bar patron headed home with a new friend after having a bit too much to drink. You don't dare to glance at the bar to see if you are being watched.
units.italian: Quelli che cercano si avvicinano al bancone e cominciano a parlare con uno dei baristi. Tu e la ragazza vi alzate. "Cammina piano," sibila sottovoce. "Ciondola. Non correre." Le metti un braccio intorno alle spalle e fai del tuo meglio per sembrare un normale avventore che torna a casa con una nuova amica dopo aver bevuto un po' troppo. Non osi guardare verso il bancone per capire se siete osservati.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	Finally you reach the door. You are in the rimway, the main passage in this ring of the station. It is crowded and brightly lit. You quicken your pace slightly and begin walking toward your ship, still afraid that if you break into a run, you will attract attention. The girl keeps glancing at the shop windows that you pass by: checking the reflection to see if anyone is following you. "They're leaving the bar," she says. And then, "They're walking in the other direction. I think we're safe."|629|0
units.english: Finally you reach the door. You are in the rimway, the main passage in this ring of the station. It is crowded and brightly lit. You quicken your pace slightly and begin walking toward your ship, still afraid that if you break into a run, you will attract attention. The girl keeps glancing at the shop windows that you pass by: checking the reflection to see if anyone is following you. "They're leaving the bar," she says. And then, "They're walking in the other direction. I think we're safe."
units.italian: Alla fine raggiungete la porta. Siete nel rimway, il passaggio principale di questo anello della stazione. È affollato e ben illuminato. Acceleri leggermente il passo e cominci a camminare verso la nave, ancora timoroso che, se ti mettessi a correre, attireresti l'attenzione. La ragazza continua a guardare le vetrine dei negozi che superate: controlla il riflesso per vedere se qualcuno vi segue. "Stanno uscendo dal bar," dice. E poi: "Stanno andando nella direzione opposta. Credo che siamo al sicuro."

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	You pass a narrow doorway, probably an entrance to one of the service tunnels. The boy is standing there, holding a gun by his side. His grim expression softens somewhat when he sees you approaching.|630|0
units.english: You pass a narrow doorway, probably an entrance to one of the service tunnels. The boy is standing there, holding a gun by his side. His grim expression softens somewhat when he sees you approaching.
units.italian: Passi davanti a una porta stretta, probabilmente l'ingresso di uno dei tunnel di servizio. Il ragazzo è lì, con una pistola tenuta lungo il fianco. La sua espressione cupa si addolcisce un po' quando ti vede avvicinare.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	You quickly make your way back to your ship. As soon as the door has closed behind you, all three of you breathe a sigh of relief. A second later, the baby begins to wail, loudly. As you show them to their bunks, they introduce themselves as Joe and Maria; the baby's name is Jesse. "I don't know how to thank you," says Maria.|634|0
units.english: You quickly make your way back to your ship. As soon as the door has closed behind you, all three of you breathe a sigh of relief. A second later, the baby begins to wail, loudly. As you show them to their bunks, they introduce themselves as Joe and Maria; the baby's name is Jesse. "I don't know how to thank you," says Maria.
units.italian: Vi dirigete in fretta verso la nave. Appena la porta si chiude dietro di voi, tutti e tre tirate un sospiro di sollievo. Un secondo dopo la neonata comincia a strillare, forte. Mentre li accompagni alle cuccette, si presentano come Joe e Maria; la bambina si chiama Jesse. "Non so come ringraziarti," dice Maria.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|	"Please don't take too long leaving the station," adds Joe. "But, I think we'll be safe here until you're ready to leave. There's no way they can search all the ships at the dock."|635|0
units.english: "Please don't take too long leaving the station," adds Joe. "But, I think we'll be safe here until you're ready to leave. There's no way they can search all the ships at the dock."
units.italian: "Per favore, non metterci troppo a lasciare la stazione," aggiunge Joe. "Ma credo che qui saremo al sicuro finché non sei pronto a partire. Non possono certo perquisire tutte le navi al molo."

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 1|dialog|638|0
units.english: You land on <planet> and look for Joe and Maria, but you realize that they were in one of your escorts that has not yet entered the system. Better depart and wait for them.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet> e cerchi Joe e Maria, ma ti accorgi che erano su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettarli.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 2|name|644|0
units.english: Refugees to <planet>
units.italian: Profughi verso <planet>

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 2|description|645|0
units.english: Unable to find work on <origin>, Joe and Maria want to travel to <destination> to see if they can get a job there.
units.italian: Non riuscendo a trovare lavoro su <origin>, Joe e Maria vogliono andare su <destination> per vedere se riescono a trovarne uno lì.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 2|As soon as you have landed, Joe finds a computer terminal and tries to look up his cousin who works here, but with no success. You go with him to the company office, where after a short wait you are ushered in to meet with a foreman. After Joe introduces himself, the man says, "I'm really sorry to tell you this, but Leroy died in a refinery fire several months ago."|652|0
units.english: As soon as you have landed, Joe finds a computer terminal and tries to look up his cousin who works here, but with no success. You go with him to the company office, where after a short wait you are ushered in to meet with a foreman. After Joe introduces himself, the man says, "I'm really sorry to tell you this, but Leroy died in a refinery fire several months ago."
units.italian: Appena siete atterrati, Joe trova un terminale e cerca di rintracciare suo cugino che lavora qui, ma senza successo. Vai con lui all'ufficio dell'azienda, dove dopo una breve attesa vi fanno entrare per incontrare un caposquadra. Dopo che Joe si è presentato, l'uomo dice: "Mi dispiace davvero dovertelo dire, ma Leroy è morto in un incendio della raffineria diversi mesi fa."

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 2|	Joe is crestfallen. After a long silence, you say, "Sir, do you have any work available for Joe? He and his family were hoping to be able to put down roots here."|653|0
units.english: Joe is crestfallen. After a long silence, you say, "Sir, do you have any work available for Joe? He and his family were hoping to be able to put down roots here."
units.italian: Joe è abbattuto. Dopo un lungo silenzio dici: "Signore, ha del lavoro per Joe? Lui e la sua famiglia speravano di potersi stabilire qui."

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 2|	"I'm sorry," says the foreman, "but we've had a ton of immigrants recently. The waiting list for new jobs is about five months long. They could stay here and hope for the best, but if they need work right away, they would be better off going to one of the Syndicate worlds, like <planet>."|654|0
units.english: "I'm sorry," says the foreman, "but we've had a ton of immigrants recently. The waiting list for new jobs is about five months long. They could stay here and hope for the best, but if they need work right away, they would be better off going to one of the Syndicate worlds, like <planet>."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace," dice il caposquadra, "ma di recente abbiamo avuto una marea di immigrati. La lista d'attesa per nuovi posti di lavoro è lunga circa cinque mesi. Potrebbero restare qui e sperare per il meglio, ma se hanno bisogno di lavoro subito, farebbero meglio ad andare su uno dei mondi del Sindacato, come <planet>."

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 2|	(Volunteer to take them to <planet>.)|656|0
units.english: (Volunteer to take them to <planet>.)
units.italian: (Offriti di portarli su <planet>.)

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 2|	(Leave them here and hope for the best.)|657|0
units.english: (Leave them here and hope for the best.)
units.italian: (Lasciali qui e spera per il meglio.)

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 2|	Despite his shock and grief, Joe is quite grateful. "You know we can't pay you, right?"|660|0
units.english: Despite his shock and grief, Joe is quite grateful. "You know we can't pay you, right?"
units.italian: Nonostante lo shock e il dolore, Joe è molto grato. "Lo sai che non possiamo pagarti, vero?"

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 2|	"Don't worry about it," you say. You return to your ship and tell the bad news to Maria.|661|0
units.english: "Don't worry about it," you say. You return to your ship and tell the bad news to Maria.
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti," dici. Torni alla nave e dai la brutta notizia a Maria.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 2|dialog|664|0
units.english: You land on <planet> and look for Joe and Maria, but you realize that they were in one of your escorts that has not yet entered the system. Better depart and wait for them.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet> e cerchi Joe e Maria, ma ti accorgi che erano su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettarli.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 2|log|667|0
units.english: Helped two teens named Joe and Maria and their daughter Jesse to escape their pirate captain. Dropped them off on Millrace where they'll start a new life.
units.italian: Hai aiutato due ragazzi di nome Joe e Maria e loro figlia Jesse a sfuggire al loro capitano pirata. Li hai lasciati su Millrace, dove inizieranno una nuova vita.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 2|You help Joe and Maria, and their daughter Jesse, to carry their few belongings down to the immigration desk, where a clerk lists the job openings available and asks them each to fill out a skill survey. Maria says, "Captain <last>, I don't know how to thank you, but I promise you that once we've got steady jobs, we'll save up and pay you our fare for transporting us here."|669|0
units.english: You help Joe and Maria, and their daughter Jesse, to carry their few belongings down to the immigration desk, where a clerk lists the job openings available and asks them each to fill out a skill survey. Maria says, "Captain <last>, I don't know how to thank you, but I promise you that once we've got steady jobs, we'll save up and pay you our fare for transporting us here."
units.italian: Aiuti Joe e Maria, e loro figlia Jesse, a portare le poche cose che hanno al banco dell'immigrazione, dove un impiegato elenca le offerte di lavoro disponibili e chiede a ciascuno di compilare un questionario sulle competenze. Maria dice: "Capitano <last>, non so come ringraziarla, ma le prometto che, appena avremo lavori stabili, risparmieremo e le pagheremo il biglietto per averci portato qui."

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den, Part 2|	You wish them the best of luck, and return to your ship.|670|0
units.english: You wish them the best of luck, and return to your ship.
units.italian: Auguri loro ogni fortuna e torni alla nave.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den: Payment|When you land, you are surprised to find a message waiting for you from Joe and Maria, the young couple you transported from Smuggler's Den to Millrace a year ago to help them and their baby escape their lives as pirate crew members. "Dear Captain <last>," they write, "we promised you we would save up enough money to pay you back for transporting us. Attached is <payment>. Thank you for giving us a chance at a new life." They've also enclosed a picture of themselves and their baby Jesse, who is now more than a year old.|687|0
units.english: When you land, you are surprised to find a message waiting for you from Joe and Maria, the young couple you transported from Smuggler's Den to Millrace a year ago to help them and their baby escape their lives as pirate crew members. "Dear Captain <last>," they write, "we promised you we would save up enough money to pay you back for transporting us. Attached is <payment>. Thank you for giving us a chance at a new life." They've also enclosed a picture of themselves and their baby Jesse, who is now more than a year old.
units.italian: Quando atterri, ti sorprende trovare un messaggio in attesa da Joe e Maria, la giovane coppia che un anno fa hai portato da Smuggler's Den a Millrace per aiutarli, insieme alla loro bambina, a sfuggire alla vita di equipaggio pirata. "Caro Capitano <last>," scrivono, "le avevamo promesso che avremmo risparmiato abbastanza da rimborsarla per il trasporto. In allegato ci sono <payment>. Grazie per averci dato una possibilità di ricominciare." Hanno anche accluso una foto di loro e della loro bambina Jesse, che ora ha più di un anno.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den: Follow Up|As you're coming in for a landing, you realize that Millrace is where Joe and Maria live, the couple you transported from Smuggler's Den. They recently wrote to you thanking you for helping them to begin a new life. Do you want to stop by and see how they are doing?|701|0
units.english: As you're coming in for a landing, you realize that Millrace is where Joe and Maria live, the couple you transported from Smuggler's Den. They recently wrote to you thanking you for helping them to begin a new life. Do you want to stop by and see how they are doing?
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini per atterrare, ti rendi conto che Millrace è il posto dove vivono Joe e Maria, la coppia che hai portato da Smuggler's Den. Ti hanno scritto da poco per ringraziarti di averli aiutati a ricominciare. Vuoi passare a vedere come stanno?

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den: Follow Up|	(Yes.)|703|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den: Follow Up|	(No.)|704|0
units.english: (No.)
units.italian: (No.)

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den: Follow Up|	You contact Joe and Maria and they say they would definitely enjoy seeing you. On your way to the workers' barracks where they live, you stop by a small store and buy some chocolate, plus bread and fresh fruit and some canned goods you think they would be able to use. They thank you for coming and welcome you into their home. Jesse is continuing to grow up, and they have another baby too, now. Joe says the work in the factories is exhausting, and the hours are long, but they never need to worry about where their next meal will come from, or what they'll be required to do to earn it. You leave feeling very glad that you have been able to make such a difference in someone's life.|706|0
units.english: You contact Joe and Maria and they say they would definitely enjoy seeing you. On your way to the workers' barracks where they live, you stop by a small store and buy some chocolate, plus bread and fresh fruit and some canned goods you think they would be able to use. They thank you for coming and welcome you into their home. Jesse is continuing to grow up, and they have another baby too, now. Joe says the work in the factories is exhausting, and the hours are long, but they never need to worry about where their next meal will come from, or what they'll be required to do to earn it. You leave feeling very glad that you have been able to make such a difference in someone's life.
units.italian: Contatti Joe e Maria e dicono che sarebbero davvero felici di vederti. Mentre vai verso le baracche dei lavoratori dove vivono, ti fermi in un piccolo negozio e compri del cioccolato, oltre a pane, frutta fresca e qualche scatoletta che pensi potrebbe esser loro utile. Ti ringraziano per essere venuto e ti accolgono in casa. Jesse continua a crescere, e ora hanno anche un altro bambino. Joe dice che il lavoro nelle fabbriche è sfiancante e gli orari sono lunghi, ma non devono mai preoccuparsi di dove verrà il prossimo pasto, né di cosa sarà loro richiesto di fare per guadagnarlo. Te ne vai sentendoti molto felice di aver potuto fare una differenza del genere nella vita di qualcuno.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den: Follow Up|log|710|0
units.english: Visited Joe and Maria on Millrace. Life is tough, but they are doing far better now than they were on a pirate ship. Jesse has grown and the couple already has another baby to look after.
units.italian: Hai fatto visita a Joe e Maria su Millrace. La vita è dura, ma stanno molto meglio di quando erano su una nave pirata. Jesse è cresciuta e la coppia ha già un altro bambino da accudire.

units.id: mission:Smuggler's Den: Follow Up|log|711|0
units.english: Two teenagers who were under the employs of pirates, the couple wanted your aid with an escape from their lives and after a time have informed you that they are now living in relative peace where you left them on Millrace.
units.italian: Due adolescenti che erano alle dipendenze dei pirati: la coppia voleva il tuo aiuto per fuggire dalla loro vita e dopo un certo tempo ti ha informato che ora vivono in relativa pace dove li hai lasciati, su Millrace.

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 1|name|717|0
units.english: Expedition to Hope
units.italian: Spedizione a Hope

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 1|description|718|0
units.english: Transport a team of <bunks> scientists to the abandoned world of <planet>, where they will be placing <tons> of meteorological equipment. Payment will be 80,000 credits.
units.italian: Trasporta una squadra di <bunks> scienziati sul mondo abbandonato di <planet>, dove sistemeranno <tons> di attrezzatura meteorologica. Il pagamento sarà di 80.000 crediti.

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 1|A group of <bunks> scientists approaches you and asks if you would be willing to take them and <cargo> to the abandoned planet of Hope, and then back home from there. "The transport we'd arranged for bailed out on us at the last moment," says their leader, a middle-aged man wearing thick-rimmed glasses. "We have 80,000 credits allocated for payment."|731|0
units.english: A group of <bunks> scientists approaches you and asks if you would be willing to take them and <cargo> to the abandoned planet of Hope, and then back home from there. "The transport we'd arranged for bailed out on us at the last moment," says their leader, a middle-aged man wearing thick-rimmed glasses. "We have 80,000 credits allocated for payment."
units.italian: Un gruppo di <bunks> scienziati si avvicina e ti chiede se saresti disposto a portarli con <cargo> sul pianeta abbandonato di Hope, e poi a riportarli a casa da lì. "Il trasporto che avevamo organizzato ci ha dato buca all'ultimo momento," dice il loro capo, un uomo di mezza età con occhiali dalla montatura spessa. "Abbiamo 80.000 crediti stanziati per il pagamento."

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 1|	"Sure, I'd be glad to help."|733|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd be glad to help."
units.italian: "Certo, sarò felice di aiutare."

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 1|	"What sort of research are you doing?"|735|0
units.english: "What sort of research are you doing?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di ricerca fate?"

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 1|	"Sorry, I don't have space for you."|736|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't have space for you."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non ho spazio per voi."

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 1|	"You probably know about the supervolcano that forced the evacuation of Hope some decades ago," he says. "My family lived on Hope back then. We want to measure how much ash is still in the air, to see how long it will be before the glaciers recede and the planet is habitable again."|738|0
units.english: "You probably know about the supervolcano that forced the evacuation of Hope some decades ago," he says. "My family lived on Hope back then. We want to measure how much ash is still in the air, to see how long it will be before the glaciers recede and the planet is habitable again."
units.italian: "Probabilmente saprà del supervulcano che qualche decennio fa costrinse a evacuare Hope," dice. "La mia famiglia viveva su Hope allora. Vogliamo misurare quanta cenere è ancora nell'aria, per capire quanto tempo passerà prima che i ghiacciai si ritirino e il pianeta torni abitabile."

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 1|	"That sounds like a worthy cause. I'd be glad to transport you."|740|0
units.english: "That sounds like a worthy cause. I'd be glad to transport you."
units.italian: "Sembra una causa degna. Sarò felice di trasportarvi."

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 1|	"Sorry, I'm not going to be headed in that direction any time soon."|742|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not going to be headed in that direction any time soon."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non andrò in quella direzione a breve."

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 1|	"Thank you," he says. You help them to load their meteorological equipment onto your ship.|745|0
units.english: "Thank you," he says. You help them to load their meteorological equipment onto your ship.
units.italian: "Grazie," dice. Lo aiuti a caricare la loro attrezzatura meteorologica sulla nave.

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 1|dialog|749|0
units.english: You enter the atmosphere of <planet>, but realize that the scientists and their equipment were on one of your escorts who hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for them.
units.italian: Entri nell'atmosfera di <planet>, ma ti accorgi che gli scienziati e la loro attrezzatura erano su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettarli.

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 2|name|757|0
units.english: Expedition to Hope
units.italian: Spedizione a Hope

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 2|description|758|0
units.english: Transport the team of <bunks> scientists home to <destination>, to receive the second half of payment.
units.italian: Riporta la squadra di <bunks> scienziati a casa su <destination>, per ricevere la seconda metà del pagamento.

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 2|You fly around the planet to several different sites that the scientists have identified as good places for their equipment. They also make some deep radar scans of the glaciers. "That's my old house, down there," says one of the scientists, pointing to the radar picture of one of the buried villages. "Under thirty meters of ice, now."|770|0
units.english: You fly around the planet to several different sites that the scientists have identified as good places for their equipment. They also make some deep radar scans of the glaciers. "That's my old house, down there," says one of the scientists, pointing to the radar picture of one of the buried villages. "Under thirty meters of ice, now."
units.italian: Sorvoli il pianeta fino a diversi siti che gli scienziati hanno individuato come buoni per la loro attrezzatura. Fanno anche alcune scansioni radar profonde dei ghiacciai. "Quella laggiù è la mia vecchia casa," dice uno degli scienziati, indicando l'immagine radar di uno dei villaggi sepolti. "Ora sotto trenta metri di ghiaccio."

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 2|	The lead scientist hands you forty thousand credits, and says, "Here's the first part of your payment. Now we need to get home to <planet>. I'll pay you the rest once we get there."|771|0
units.english: The lead scientist hands you forty thousand credits, and says, "Here's the first part of your payment. Now we need to get home to <planet>. I'll pay you the rest once we get there."
units.italian: Lo scienziato a capo ti consegna quarantamila crediti e dice: "Ecco la prima parte del pagamento. Ora dobbiamo tornare a casa, su <planet>. Ti pagherò il resto quando saremo arrivati."

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 2|dialog|775|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that the scientists and their equipment were on one of your escorts who hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for them.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che gli scienziati e la loro attrezzatura erano su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettarli.

units.id: mission:Expedition to Hope 2|dialog|778|0
units.english: You drop the team of scientists off on <planet>. They thank you for helping them out, and pay you <payment>.
units.italian: Scarichi la squadra di scienziati su <planet>. Ti ringraziano per l'aiuto e ti pagano <payment>.

units.id: mission:Transport Workers A|name|783|0
units.english: Transport Family
units.italian: Trasporto famiglia

units.id: mission:Transport Workers A|description|784|0
units.english: Transport a family of <bunks>, as well as <cargo>, to <destination>, where they hope that steady work will be easier to come by. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Trasporta una famiglia di <bunks>, oltre a <cargo>, fino a <destination>, dove sperano che un lavoro stabile sia più facile da trovare. Il pagamento è di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Transport Workers A|dialog|797|0
units.english: In one of the corners of the spaceport, you meet a family with two kids, and a pile of trunks and boxes spread out next to them. They tell you that they are trying to book passage to <planet>. "Work has gotten way too hard to come by here," explains the father. "I've had seven different jobs in the past year, and none of them lasted more than a month. So we thought we'd try our luck on a Syndicate world. We can pay you <payment> for the trouble."
units.italian: In uno degli angoli dello spazioporto incontri una famiglia con due bambini e un mucchio di bauli e scatole sparsi accanto. Ti dicono che stanno cercando un passaggio per <planet>. "Qui è diventato troppo difficile trovare lavoro," spiega il padre. "Ho avuto sette lavori diversi nell'ultimo anno, e nessuno è durato più di un mese. Così abbiamo pensato di tentare la fortuna su un mondo del Sindacato. Possiamo pagarle <payment> per il disturbo."

units.id: mission:Transport Workers A|dialog|804|0
units.english: You drop off the family from <origin>, and wish them the best of luck on <planet>. They seem optimistic, and their kids are still quite excited about having taken their first ever space journey. You're sure that they will be remembering this trip for years to come. Their parents thank you, and pay you <payment>.
units.italian: Scarichi la famiglia da <origin> e auguri loro ogni fortuna su <planet>. Sembrano ottimisti, e i loro bambini sono ancora molto eccitati per aver fatto il loro primo viaggio nello spazio. Sei certo che ricorderanno questo viaggio per anni. I genitori ti ringraziano e ti pagano <payment>.

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|name|809|0
units.english: Transport Worker
units.italian: Trasporto lavoratore

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|description|810|0
units.english: This young man is headed to the factories on <destination>. He says he wants to save enough money to be able to ask his "true love" to marry him.
units.italian: Questo ragazzo è diretto alle fabbriche su <destination>. Dice che vuole mettere da parte abbastanza soldi per chiedere al suo "vero amore" di sposarlo.

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|As you are walking through the spaceport, a young man approaches you and says, "Excuse me, Captain. Is there any chance you're traveling towards the Core?" He's probably in his late teens, barely more than a kid.|821|0
units.english: As you are walking through the spaceport, a young man approaches you and says, "Excuse me, Captain. Is there any chance you're traveling towards the Core?" He's probably in his late teens, barely more than a kid.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, un ragazzo ti si avvicina e dice: "Mi scusi, Capitano. Per caso sta andando verso il Nucleo?" Avrà forse diciannove anni, poco più che un ragazzo.

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|	"I'm sure I could work that into my plans. Where are you headed?"|823|0
units.english: "I'm sure I could work that into my plans. Where are you headed?"
units.italian: "Sono sicuro di poterlo inserire nei miei piani. Dove deve andare?"

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|	"You're traveling all by yourself? You aren't in any trouble, I hope?"|824|0
units.english: "You're traveling all by yourself? You aren't in any trouble, I hope?"
units.italian: "Viaggia tutto da solo? Spero che non abbia problemi."

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|	"Sorry, I don't expect to be headed that way any time soon."|825|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't expect to be headed that way any time soon."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non credo che andrò in quella direzione a breve."

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|	"Well, here's the story," he says. "My girlfriend's father won't let us get married until I have some money saved up. They say there's plenty of jobs to be had on <planet>. So I'm headed there to put down roots and get myself established, then in a year or two she can come and join me. Don't worry, I have <payment> that I can give to you."|827|0
units.english: "Well, here's the story," he says. "My girlfriend's father won't let us get married until I have some money saved up. They say there's plenty of jobs to be had on <planet>. So I'm headed there to put down roots and get myself established, then in a year or two she can come and join me. Don't worry, I have <payment> that I can give to you."
units.italian: "Beh, la storia è questa," dice. "Il padre della mia ragazza non ci lascia sposare finché non avrò messo da parte un po' di soldi. Dicono che ci sono un sacco di lavori su <planet>. Così vado lì a mettere radici e a sistemarmi, poi tra un anno o due lei potrà venire a raggiungermi. Non si preoccupi, ho <payment> da darle."

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|	"I'd be glad to take you there."|829|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to take you there."
units.italian: "Sarò felice di portarla lì."

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|	"Are you sure about that? I've heard some bad things about the Syndicate's company towns."|831|0
units.english: "Are you sure about that? I've heard some bad things about the Syndicate's company towns."
units.italian: "Ne è sicuro? Ho sentito cose brutte sulle città aziendali del Sindacato."

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|	"Just because there's jobs doesn't mean it's going to be easy pay. Trust me, I've been there before."|834|0
units.english: "Just because there's jobs doesn't mean it's going to be easy pay. Trust me, I've been there before."
units.italian: "Il fatto che ci siano lavori non significa che sia facile guadagnare. Fidati, ci sono già passato."

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|	"Do you really think she's going to wait around for you?"|838|0
units.english: "Do you really think she's going to wait around for you?"
units.italian: "Crede davvero che lei lo aspetterà?"

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|	"Me too," he says, "but it's a lifetime of steady work, and you know how hard that is to come by in this part of the galaxy. Can you help me out?"|840|0
units.english: "Me too," he says, "but it's a lifetime of steady work, and you know how hard that is to come by in this part of the galaxy. Can you help me out?"
units.italian: "Anch'io," dice, "ma è una vita di lavoro stabile, e sai quanto sia difficile trovarlo da queste parti della galassia. Puoi darmi una mano?"

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|label|842|0
units.english: towns syndicate
units.italian: towns syndicate

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|	"I know," he says, "but it's still better than trying to find work in this part of the galaxy. Can you help me out?"|843|0
units.english: "I know," he says, "but it's still better than trying to find work in this part of the galaxy. Can you help me out?"
units.italian: "Lo so," dice, "ma è comunque meglio che cercare lavoro da queste parti della galassia. Puoi darmi una mano?"

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|	"She'll be true to me," he says, with absolute confidence.|846|0
units.english: "She'll be true to me," he says, with absolute confidence.
units.italian: "Mi sarà fedele," dice, con assoluta sicurezza.

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|	"Okay, I'll take you to <planet>."|850|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll take you to <planet>."
units.italian: "Va bene, ti porto su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|	"Sorry, I'm not headed in that direction."|852|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not headed in that direction."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non vado in quella direzione."

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|	"Thank you, Captain," he says, shaking your hand. You bring him aboard your ship and show him to one of the empty bunks.|855|0
units.english: "Thank you, Captain," he says, shaking your hand. You bring him aboard your ship and show him to one of the empty bunks.
units.italian: "Grazie, Capitano," dice, stringendoti la mano. Lo fai salire a bordo e gli mostri una cuccetta libera.

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|log|863|0
units.english: Transported a teenage boy to Maker so that he can work to marry his girlfriend.
units.italian: Hai trasportato un ragazzo fino a Maker perché possa lavorare e sposare la sua ragazza.

units.id: mission:Transport Workers B|dialog|864|0
units.english: You drop off the young man from <origin> who is hoping to find work and save enough money for his girlfriend to join him. "Good luck," you say. "Be wise. Don't let yourself get into debt." He thanks you, and pays you <payment>.
units.italian: Scarichi il ragazzo da <origin> che spera di trovare lavoro e di mettere da parte abbastanza soldi perché la sua ragazza possa raggiungerlo. "Buona fortuna," dici. "Sii saggio. Non farti carico di debiti." Ti ringrazia e ti paga <payment>.

units.id: mission:Transport Workers C|name|869|0
units.english: Farming Family
units.italian: Famiglia di contadini

units.id: mission:Transport Workers C|description|870|0
units.english: Transport this family of <bunks> farmers and <tons> of livestock, to <destination>. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Trasporta questa famiglia di <bunks> contadini e <tons> di bestiame fino a <destination>. Il pagamento è di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Transport Workers C|On the dirt near your landing pad is parked a large wagon, hitched to a draft horse and loaded down with furniture and various farming implements. A family is gathered in the shade of the cart, and several goats and sheep are tied up behind it.|885|0
units.english: On the dirt near your landing pad is parked a large wagon, hitched to a draft horse and loaded down with furniture and various farming implements. A family is gathered in the shade of the cart, and several goats and sheep are tied up behind it.
units.italian: Sulla terra battuta vicino alla tua piazzola di atterraggio è parcheggiato un grande carro, attaccato a un cavallo da tiro e carico di mobili e attrezzi agricoli di vario tipo. Una famiglia è radunata all'ombra del carro, e dietro di esso sono legate diverse capre e pecore.

units.id: mission:Transport Workers C|	(Approach the farmers.)|887|0
units.english: (Approach the farmers.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati ai contadini.)

units.id: mission:Transport Workers C|	(I'm not interested in carrying livestock in my shiny new space ship.)|888|0
units.english: (I'm not interested in carrying livestock in my shiny new space ship.)
units.italian: (Non mi interessa trasportare bestiame nella mia nuova e scintillante nave spaziale.)

units.english: The farmers introduce themselves as Jim and Annette Patterson; their kids are Erin, Kyle, and Sarah. "Any chance you've got space for <tons> of livestock?" asks Jim. "The droughts the last few years have been fierce, and we're hoping to start a new homestead on <planet>. We have <payment> saved for payment."
units.italian: I contadini si presentano come Jim e Annette Patterson; i loro figli sono Erin, Kyle e Sarah. "Per caso ha spazio per <tons> di bestiame?" chiede Jim. "Le siccità degli ultimi anni sono state feroci, e speriamo di avviare un nuovo podere su <planet>. Abbiamo <payment> da parte per il pagamento."

units.id: mission:Transport Workers C|	"Sure, I'd be glad to take you there."|892|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd be glad to take you there."
units.italian: "Certo, sarò felice di portarvi lì."

units.id: mission:Transport Workers C|	"Sorry, that's way too far from here."|894|0
units.english: "Sorry, that's way too far from here."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, è troppo lontano da qui."

units.id: mission:Transport Workers C|dialog|902|0
units.english: You drop off the Pattersons, the farm family from <origin>, and help them to unload their wagon and cattle from your cargo hold. They thank you, and Jim pays you <payment>.
units.italian: Scarichi i Patterson, la famiglia di contadini da <origin>, e li aiuti a sbarcare il carro e il bestiame dalla stiva. Ti ringraziano, e Jim ti paga <payment>.

units.id: mission:Transport Workers C|log|903|0
units.english: An unusual family who needed you to make a very unconventional trip with a sizable number of farm animals that had to be kept happy in an enclosed area of your spaceship.
units.italian: Una famiglia insolita che aveva bisogno che facessi un viaggio molto poco convenzionale con un numero considerevole di animali da fattoria, che dovevano restare contenti in uno spazio chiuso della tua nave.

units.id: mission:WR Star 1|name|908|0
units.english: Star Research
units.italian: Ricerca stellare

units.id: mission:WR Star 1|description|909|0
units.english: Fly through the <waypoints> system with a team of <bunks> scientists and <cargo>, then return them to <destination>.
units.italian: Attraversa il sistema <waypoints> con una squadra di <bunks> scienziati e <cargo>, poi riportali su <destination>.

units.id: mission:WR Star 1|dialog|920|0
units.english: A group of <bunks> scientists approaches you and asks if you will be headed to the Rim any time soon. "We're doing research on Wolf-Rayet stars," they explain, "and we're hoping to find a captain who can do a flyby of <waypoints>." Scientific research in the Deep is notoriously well-funded, so they will probably pay you quite well.
units.italian: Un gruppo di <bunks> scienziati ti si avvicina e chiede se andrai verso il Rim a breve. "Stiamo facendo ricerche sulle stelle Wolf-Rayet," spiegano, "e speriamo di trovare un capitano che possa fare un sorvolo di <waypoints>." La ricerca scientifica nel Deep è notoriamente ben finanziata, quindi probabilmente ti pagheranno piuttosto bene.

units.id: mission:WR Star 1|dialog|922|0
units.english: The team of scientists unpacks their equipment and takes some measurements of the star. Before long they inform you they are ready to go home.
units.italian: La squadra di scienziati scarica la sua attrezzatura e prende alcune misure della stella. Prima di molto ti informano che sono pronti a tornare a casa.

units.id: mission:WR Star 1|dialog|927|0
units.english: The team of scientists thanks you for bringing them to <waypoints> and back, and pays you <payment>. They seem eager to get back to their lab and start analyzing their measurements.
units.italian: La squadra di scienziati ti ringrazia per averli portati a <waypoints> e ritorno, e ti paga <payment>. Sembrano impazienti di tornare in laboratorio e cominciare ad analizzare le loro misurazioni.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|name|932|0
units.english: Transport band to <planet>
units.italian: Trasporta la band su <planet>

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|description|933|0
units.english: Give the band "There Might Be Riots" a ride to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta la band "There Might Be Riots" fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|A woman in a well-tailored suit approaches you. "Captain <last>?" You nod. "Are you available for a transport job?" she asks.|946|0
units.english: A woman in a well-tailored suit approaches you. "Captain <last>?" You nod. "Are you available for a transport job?" she asks.
units.italian: Una donna in un abito ben tagliato ti si avvicina. "Capitano <last>?" Fai cenno di sì. "È disponibile per un lavoro di trasporto?" chiede.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	"What is it?"|948|0
units.english: "What is it?"
units.italian: "Di che si tratta?"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	"Not right now."|949|0
units.english: "Not right now."
units.italian: "Non adesso."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	"My name is Becca," she says. "I'm a stage manager for a band, and the transport we had under contract bailed out on us. Any chance you could take <fare> and <tons> of cargo to <destination>? Given the circumstances, we can pay quite well."|951|0
units.english: "My name is Becca," she says. "I'm a stage manager for a band, and the transport we had under contract bailed out on us. Any chance you could take <fare> and <tons> of cargo to <destination>? Given the circumstances, we can pay quite well."
units.italian: "Mi chiamo Becca," dice. "Sono direttrice di scena per una band, e il trasporto che avevamo sotto contratto ci ha dato buca. Per caso potrebbe portare <fare> e <tons> di carico su <destination>? Date le circostanze, possiamo pagare piuttosto bene."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	"Sure!"|953|0
units.english: "Sure!"
units.italian: "Certo!"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	"Sorry, I'm not headed in that direction right now."|954|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not headed in that direction right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non vado in quella direzione adesso."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	"Great," she says, "I'll tell the boys to start loading their gear into your ship." About a half an hour later the road crew begins carting instruments and amplifiers into your cargo hold. Soon after that, you hear the roar of a crowd in the distance and another group of men comes running into your ship. "We're with the band," they say. "Quick, shut the hatch." Half a minute later, a mob of people has surrounded your ship and a few of them are even climbing on top of it. It takes you a second to realize they're not angry or bent on destruction - they're just a group of crazy fans.|956|0
units.english: "Great," she says, "I'll tell the boys to start loading their gear into your ship." About a half an hour later the road crew begins carting instruments and amplifiers into your cargo hold. Soon after that, you hear the roar of a crowd in the distance and another group of men comes running into your ship. "We're with the band," they say. "Quick, shut the hatch." Half a minute later, a mob of people has surrounded your ship and a few of them are even climbing on top of it. It takes you a second to realize they're not angry or bent on destruction - they're just a group of crazy fans.
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice, "dirò ai ragazzi di cominciare a caricare l'attrezzatura sulla sua nave." Circa mezz'ora dopo la troupe comincia a portare strumenti e amplificatori nella stiva. Poco dopo senti il ruggito di una folla in lontananza e un altro gruppo di uomini entra di corsa nella nave. "Siamo con la band," dicono. "Svelti, chiudete il portello." Mezzo minuto dopo una folla di persone ha circondato la nave e alcuni stanno perfino salendo sopra. Ti serve un secondo per capire che non sono arrabbiati né intenzionati a distruggere nulla: sono solo un gruppo di fan scatenati.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	"Happens everywhere we go," says one of the musicians, calmly, as he watches a video feed of the mob on one of your monitors. He tells you that he's Ulrich, the lead singer. Then he introduces the rest of the singers and musicians.|957|0
units.english: "Happens everywhere we go," says one of the musicians, calmly, as he watches a video feed of the mob on one of your monitors. He tells you that he's Ulrich, the lead singer. Then he introduces the rest of the singers and musicians.
units.italian: "Succede ovunque andiamo," dice uno dei musicisti, con calma, guardando il video della folla su uno dei tuoi monitor. Ti dice di chiamarsi Ulrich, il cantante. Poi ti presenta il resto dei cantanti e dei musicisti.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	"Pleased to meet you all. What's the name of your band?"|959|0
units.english: "Pleased to meet you all. What's the name of your band?"
units.italian: "Piacere di conoscervi tutti. Come si chiama la vostra band?"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	"Oh," Ulrich says, "we call ourselves, 'There Might Be Riots.'"|960|0
units.english: "Oh," Ulrich says, "we call ourselves, 'There Might Be Riots.'"
units.italian: "Oh," dice Ulrich, "ci chiamiamo 'There Might Be Riots'."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	Eventually, the spaceport police arrive and disperse the crowd, and the band settles in for their trip to <destination>.|961|0
units.english: Eventually, the spaceport police arrive and disperse the crowd, and the band settles in for their trip to <destination>.
units.italian: Alla fine arriva la polizia dello spazioporto e disperde la folla, e la band si sistema per il viaggio verso <destination>.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|dialog|965|0
units.english: You arrive on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the band and their supplies has not arrived yet. Better depart and wait for your escorts to enter the system.
units.italian: Arrivi su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta che porta la band e le sue attrezzature non è ancora arrivata. Meglio partire e aspettare che le tue scorte entrino nel sistema.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|log|969|0
units.english: Dropped the famous band "There Might Be Riots" off on Wayfarer. They drew quite the crowd, and paid very well.
units.italian: Hai lasciato la famosa band "There Might Be Riots" su Wayfarer. Hanno richiamato una bella folla e pagato molto bene.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|You drop off the band "There Might Be Riots" on <destination>. Along the way, you got to hear some of their music, which is mostly characterized by frenzied instrumentals, a very energetic brass section, and bizarre lyrics. One day while you were in transit, they nearly drove you insane by playing their catchy but nonsensical song "Henhouse In Your Soul" for four hours straight, but other than that they have been good passengers, and their stage manager gives you an incredibly generous payment of <payment>.|971|0
units.english: You drop off the band "There Might Be Riots" on <destination>. Along the way, you got to hear some of their music, which is mostly characterized by frenzied instrumentals, a very energetic brass section, and bizarre lyrics. One day while you were in transit, they nearly drove you insane by playing their catchy but nonsensical song "Henhouse In Your Soul" for four hours straight, but other than that they have been good passengers, and their stage manager gives you an incredibly generous payment of <payment>.
units.italian: Scarichi la band "There Might Be Riots" su <destination>. Lungo il viaggio hai potuto ascoltare un po' della loro musica, caratterizzata soprattutto da strumentali frenetici, una sezione di ottoni molto energica e testi bizzarri. Un giorno, durante il trasferimento, ti hanno quasi fatto impazzire suonando per quattro ore di fila la loro canzone orecchiabile ma senza senso "Henhouse In Your Soul", ma a parte questo sono stati buoni passeggeri, e la loro direttrice di scena ti dà un pagamento incredibilmente generoso di <payment>.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	"We've already got a gig lined up for tonight," says Ulrich. "Want to come? We'll give you free tickets." Given how well they just paid you, it might be worth going just to build a relationship with the band, even if not for the music itself.|972|0
units.english: "We've already got a gig lined up for tonight," says Ulrich. "Want to come? We'll give you free tickets." Given how well they just paid you, it might be worth going just to build a relationship with the band, even if not for the music itself.
units.italian: "Abbiamo già un concerto fissato per stasera," dice Ulrich. "Vuoi venire? Ti diamo i biglietti gratis." Dato quanto bene ti hanno appena pagato, potrebbe valere la pena andarci solo per costruire un rapporto con la band, anche se non per la musica in sé.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	"Sure!"|974|0
units.english: "Sure!"
units.italian: "Ma certo!"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	"Sorry, I've got other things to do."|975|0
units.english: "Sorry, I've got other things to do."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ho altre cose da fare."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	The band is even louder in concert than they were when practicing in the confines of your ship. About thirty minutes into the concert, the energy of the crowd and the surreal lyrics finally begin to soak in, and rather than seeming meaningless their music feels fraught with meaning that hovers just beyond your grasp.|977|0
units.english: The band is even louder in concert than they were when practicing in the confines of your ship. About thirty minutes into the concert, the energy of the crowd and the surreal lyrics finally begin to soak in, and rather than seeming meaningless their music feels fraught with meaning that hovers just beyond your grasp.
units.italian: La band è ancora più rumorosa in concerto di quanto fosse alle prove negli spazi angusti della tua nave. Dopo circa mezz'ora di concerto, l'energia della folla e i testi surreali finalmente ti penetrano, e invece di sembrare privi di senso la loro musica ti pare carica di un significato che aleggia appena oltre la tua portata.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	Finally the band announces that their last song will be "Sad Archie." You've never heard of it, but the fans scream in approval. It's a slow, ballad-like song about a man named Archie who lives forever and is sad because the friends he makes all grow old and die. Archie has a pet dragon, and he builds a beautiful house for the dragon, but the dragon dies young. Archie is so sad seeing the dragon's house empty and gathering dust that he rents it out to some friends, but they fight with each other and trash the place. The story makes no sense, but some of the fans are wiping away tears as the song ends.|978|0
units.english: Finally the band announces that their last song will be "Sad Archie." You've never heard of it, but the fans scream in approval. It's a slow, ballad-like song about a man named Archie who lives forever and is sad because the friends he makes all grow old and die. Archie has a pet dragon, and he builds a beautiful house for the dragon, but the dragon dies young. Archie is so sad seeing the dragon's house empty and gathering dust that he rents it out to some friends, but they fight with each other and trash the place. The story makes no sense, but some of the fans are wiping away tears as the song ends.
units.italian: Alla fine la band annuncia che l'ultima canzone sarà "Sad Archie". Non ne hai mai sentito parlare, ma i fan urlano di approvazione. È una canzone lenta, da ballata, su un uomo di nome Archie che vive per sempre ed è triste perché tutti gli amici che si fa invecchiano e muoiono. Archie ha un drago come animale domestico, e costruisce per il drago una casa bellissima, ma il drago muore giovane. Archie è così triste a vedere la casa del drago vuota e piena di polvere che la affitta a degli amici, ma loro litigano tra loro e devastano il posto. La storia non ha alcun senso, ma alcuni fan si asciugano le lacrime mentre la canzone finisce.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	Becca, who is sitting next to you in the VIP section, says, "We learned years ago that we need to end every concert with a sad song. Otherwise the fans leave with way too much energy and start destroying public property."|979|0
units.english: Becca, who is sitting next to you in the VIP section, says, "We learned years ago that we need to end every concert with a sad song. Otherwise the fans leave with way too much energy and start destroying public property."
units.italian: Becca, seduta accanto a te nella zona VIP, dice: "Abbiamo imparato anni fa che dobbiamo chiudere ogni concerto con una canzone triste. Altrimenti i fan se ne vanno con troppa energia e cominciano a distruggere la proprietà pubblica."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots 1|	The concert ends, and you say goodbye to the band. They say they'll be in touch if they ever need a ride again.|980|0
units.english: The concert ends, and you say goodbye to the band. They say they'll be in touch if they ever need a ride again.
units.italian: Il concerto finisce e saluti la band. Dicono che si faranno sentire se avranno ancora bisogno di un passaggio.
